name: Alexian Brothers Urge to Self-Injure Scale (ABUSI)
sourceInstrument: Alexian Brothers Urge to Self-Injure Scale (user-supplied reproduction text)
directions: Past week. This measure concerns urges to self-injure and does not determine suicidal intent.
timeframe: Past week. This measure concerns urges to self-injure and does not determine suicidal intent.

questions.text: How often have you thought about injuring yourself or about how you want to injure yourself?

scale.label: Never / 0 times in the last week
Rarely / 1–2 times in the last week
Occasionally / 3–4 times in the last week
Sometimes / 5–10 times in the last week, OR 1–2 times a day
Often / 11–20 times in the last week, OR 2–3 times a day
Most of the time / 20–40 times in the last week, OR 3–5 times a day
Nearly all of the time / More than 40 times in the last week, OR more than 6 times a day

questions.text: At the most severe point, how strong was your urge to self-injure in the last week?

scale.label: Slight, that is, a very mild urge
Strong urge, but difficult to control
Strong urge and would have self-injured if able to

questions.text: How much time have you spent thinking about injuring yourself or about how you want to injure yourself?
How difficult was it to resist injuring yourself in the last week?
Keeping in mind your responses to the previous questions, please rate your overall average urge or desire to injure yourself in the last week.

scale.label: Never thought about it and never had the urge to self-injure
Rarely thought about it and rarely had the urge to self-injure
Occasionally thought about it and occasionally had the urge to self-injure
Sometimes thought about it and sometimes had the urge to self-injure
Often thought about it and often had the urge to self-injure
Thought about self-injury most of the time and had the urge to do it most of the time
Thought about self-injury nearly all the time and had the urge to do it nearly all the time

interpretationNote: This form and scoring profile were entered from user-supplied material. Results are screening or descriptive information only and do not establish a diagnosis.
